S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  02.09.2025 ABA No.865 of 2025  Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

The applicant no.1 Sahil Ahmad has filed an Application (Miscellaneous Application No.01 of 2025)
for permission to go to Canada for employment.
He has passport and he has been granted visa to travel to Canada.

2. Heard Mr. Aditya Pratap Singh, learned counsel (through video conferencing) for applicants and Mr. Tumul Nainwal, learned Assistant Government Advocate for respondent.
3. The Investigating Officer was requested to be present through video conferencing to clarify whether the applicant Sahil Ahmad is involved in any other case or not, and objection to the Application, if any.
4.
Mr. Prahalad Bisht, the Investigating Officer, is present through video conferencing.
He has submitted that a charge-sheet has already been filed in FIR No.124 of 2022, but statement of the applicant Sahil Ahmad and his interrogation are required in the present matter.
He further submitted that he will take the statements of the applicant and complete the interrogation by 04.09.2025.
5. Mr. Aditya Pratap Singh, Advocate, on instructions, submitted that the applicant Sahil Ahmad shall appear before the Investigating Officer for his statement and interrogations.

6. Mr. Aditya Pratap Singh, Advocate, submitted that the applicant has been acquitted of the offence under Sections 323, 354, 354C, 376 read with Section 511, 377, 379A and Section 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 in the matter of FIR No.203 of 2021, registered at Police Station Yamunanagar,
Haryana and the proceedings arising from the First Information Report No.124 of 2022 are stayed in C482 No.2475 of 2023.

7. Applicant no.1 is directed to clarify the following facts through his affidavit:-
(i) Whether any appeal is pending against his acquittal?
ABA/865/2025 on 2 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132892032/
1
(ii) Whether permission has been obtained in the said stayed case.

8. Mr. Aditya Pratap Singh, Advocate, has sought time to clarify the said circumstances and to file an affidavit of the father of the applicant no.1.
9.

Mr. Tumul Nainwal, learned Assistant Government Advocate, has also asked two days' time to ascertain if any other cases are registered/pending against the applicant no.1.
10.
Time is granted.
11. On the request of learned counsel for the parties, list on 08.09.2025 as a first case.
12. The Investigating Officer is directed to appear through video conferencing before this Court on 08.09.2025 at 10:30 a.m. (Alok Kumar Verma, J.)
